description: This is a PHP test class for the EmployeeLanguageAPI, specifically designed for testing the API endpoints related to employee language data in the OrangeHRM project. The class contains multiple unit tests covering CRUD operations, validation rules, and service interactions for employee language entities.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeLanguageAPI, testing CRUD operations, validation, and service interactions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data for testing from a YAML file into the database.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Tests that the API returns a proper EmployeeLanguageService instance.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee language entry via the API, including success and not found cases.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the API validation rules for the 'getOne' operation, including authorization checks.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all language entries for an employee, including pagination and total count.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the API validation rules for the 'getAll' operation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee language entry via the API, including validation and error handling.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the API rules for creating a new language entry, including required fields and value constraints.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee language entry, including success and not found cases.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the API validation rules when updating an employee language entry.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting an employee language entry via the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the delete operation, ensuring proper structure and permissions.
